patches.name: output-1080p
patches.description: Renders and presents at 1920x1080 instead of 3840x2160. The PS5 build sizes its window and back buffers from PS5.DefaultBackBufferWidth/Height (registered as 3840x2160, read-only), then resizes the window to the saved ResolutionSizeX/Y through r.SetRes, which it rewrites to 3840x2160. The first two edits register the cvars as 1920x1080; the third makes the r.SetRes sink skip the window resize.
